theme: Văn hoá công sở đa quốc gia

vocab.example: Our Paris office is in a different time zone, so we meet at 3 p.m. our time.
vocab.example_vi: Văn phòng Paris ở múi giờ khác, nên chúng tôi họp lúc 3 giờ chiều giờ mình.

vocab.example: The company runs a cultural awareness workshop for every new expat.
vocab.example_vi: Công ty tổ chức buổi workshop về hiểu biết văn hoá cho mỗi nhân viên nước ngoài mới.

vocab.example: My German manager is very direct, but she is always fair.
vocab.example_vi: Quản lý người Đức của tôi rất thẳng thắn, nhưng chị ấy luôn công bằng.

vocab.example: In Vietnam, people are often indirect when they want to say no.
vocab.example_vi: Ở Việt Nam, mọi người thường nói vòng khi muốn từ chối.

vocab.example: I gave him feedback in private, because saving face is important in our culture.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi góp ý riêng với anh ấy vì giữ thể diện rất quan trọng trong văn hoá của chúng ta.

vocab.meaning_vi: khung giờ làm việc trùng nhau
vocab.example: Our working hours overlap with the London team only from 2 to 5 p.m.
vocab.example_vi: Giờ làm việc của chúng tôi chỉ trùng với nhóm London từ 2 đến 5 giờ chiều.

vocab.example: Some colleagues need more personal space, so do not stand too close.
vocab.example_vi: Một số đồng nghiệp cần nhiều khoảng cách cá nhân hơn, nên đừng đứng quá gần.

vocab.example: It is respectful to ask before you share a photo of a colleague online.
vocab.example_vi: Hỏi trước khi chia sẻ ảnh đồng nghiệp lên mạng là cách cư xử tôn trọng.

listening.title: Working with the new office in Australia

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Executive)
lines.text: Minh, how is your first month working with the Sydney team?

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Coordinator)
lines.text: It's good, but the time zone is tricky. They are four hours ahead of us.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Executive)
lines.text: So you have meetings early in the morning?

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Coordinator)
lines.text: Yes, at seven thirty. Also, everyone is on a first name basis. I called the director "Mr. Jack" and people smiled.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Executive)
lines.text: That's a common cultural difference. Just call him Jack. It's not rude there.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Coordinator)
lines.text: I see. They are also very direct in meetings. At first I thought they were angry.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Executive)
lines.text: They aren't angry. Being direct helps them save time. You can ask questions directly too.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Coordinator)
lines.text: Good to know. I also send a summary after each call, because our working hours overlap only a little.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Executive)
lines.text: Smart. And remember to check their public holidays when you plan deadlines.

lines.speaker: Minh (Project Coordinator)
lines.text: Thanks, Hoa. I will add them to the shared calendar today.

questions.q: Why are Minh’s meetings early in the morning?
options: The director is busy in the afternoon
